assets.prompt: Production-ready game environment asset. A beautiful highly detailed hand-painted architectural illustration for a warehouse management game, DIRECTLY OVERHEAD at 90 degrees, roof removed, perfectly orthographic, no isometric angle, no visible wall facades, no vanishing point. Landscape 3:2 composition. Show one enormous rectangular indoor agricultural warehouse hall with warm light grey poured concrete flooring, convincing concrete grain, hairline slab expansion joints, soft accumulated wear, thick ivory masonry perimeter walls, subtle cast shadows, steel structural details, slim overhead utility conduits along the OUTSIDE edges. A broad industrial delivery doorway at the bottom edge and a restrained yellow hazard stripe threshold. Outside the hall are slim dark desaturated blue-grey exterior margins. Lighting is soft, bright and natural, with very gentle warm industrial ambient light. Interior floor must occupy a precisely rectangular region from x=10% to x=90% and y=12% to y=87% of the image, with absolutely no props encroaching on that interior rectangle. Ratio of the rectangle must be 1.6 (40 units wide by 25 units tall). Entire interior floor is EMPTY, continuous and usable; no plants, no furnishings, no internal walls, no pots, no shelving, no machinery, no zones, no interior objects. Border details and shadows give the empty building believable physical volume. Painterly realism with delicate material texture and elegant game art finish, crisp enough to inspect at high zoom; beige concrete, off-white plaster, muted steel. Not a flat vector diagram. Not a wireframe. No text, no numbers, no logos, no labels, no grid, no UI. Keep rectangular walls aligned parallel to image edges. This image is a background to which the game adds actual owned equipment and plants dynamically.
assets.purpose: Decorative top-down room; editable culture grid overlays x168/y120, 40×25 cells of 30 image units.
